[p1]
Embedded Solutions
for Transportation and Industrial Markets
www.men.de/products/09NM30-.html
NM30 – Managed 8-Port Rugged Industrial
Ethernet Switch
n Managed 8-port rugged Ethernet switch
n Fast or Gb BASE-T Ethernet via M12 connectors on
the front panel
n PoE+ Power Sourcing Equipment (PSE ), up to 60 W
output power
n Special switch protocols including Quality of Service
(QoS)
n Up to 4096 VLANs
n Redundancy and flow control
n Rugged aluminium enclosure with IP40 protection
n Fanless and maintenance-free design
n Ultra wide range power supply input (14.4 to 154
VDC) with interruption class S2
n -40°C to +70 (+85)°C operating temperature
n Compliant to EN 50155 (railways)
n Compliant to ISO 7637-2 (E-mark for automotive)
The NM30 family is a range of 8-port fanless and different application requirements including with or without PoE+
maintenance-free managed Ethernet switches, (Power Over Ethernet +), and either 100 Mb or 1Gb Ethernet interfaces.
developed specifically for rough environmental
conditions in rolling stock and automotive applications. The voltage supply for the NM30 Managed Ethernet Switch is designed
for maximum flexibility and supports wide range input supply voltages
The NM30 range of managed switches provide the from 14.4 to 154 VDC, and meets all EN50155 class S2 requirements for
additional ability to configure, manage and monitor voltages ranging 24 to 110 VDC.
the LAN which allows more control over how data
travels through the network and who has access. The The NM30 is designed for fanless operation at temperatures ranging
switch also includes special switch protocols like QoS from -40 to +70°C. Its special aluminium housing has ingress protection
(Quality of Service) to prioritize network traffic, as well IP40 and cooling fins which serve as a heatsink for the internal
as virtual LANs (VLANs), redundancy and port electronics, and in this way provides conduction cooling.
mirroring.
As a member of MEN's family of extremely rugged industrial box PCs,
The NM30 range provide eight channels at the front the NM30 provides the same flexibility and scalability, as well as a look
panel, accessible through M12 connectors and cover and feel which is common to the family.

Supported Port Types n The following configurations are available:
o 8x 10/100BASE-T managed switch (Model: 09NM30-00)

Protocols and Functionality n General Network Support
o IPv4
o IPv6 Ready
o IPv6 Ready Phase 2
n Host Configuration Protocols
o DHCP Server / Client
o DHCP Option 82
o DHCP Snooping
o DHCP ARP Inspection
n DNS
o DNS Client (RFC 2136)
o DNS Proxy (RFC 5625)

n ETH Signal Equalization and Power Control

n PerfectReach™
n Inband management (VRAP)

Monitoring o Link OAM: IEEE 802.3ah (a.k.a. EFM)

o SMAC/DMAC Swap

n SNMP v1 Traps (RFC 1157) with multiple destinations

n TIA 1057 LLDP-MED extensions

n Syslog (RFC 5424)
n sFlow (RFC 3176)

n Fallback Firmware
Configuration Management n TFTP (RFC 1350)
n Fallback Configuration
n Configurable by Web / CLI / Telnet /SSL / Console

QoS n Active Priority Queues per Port: 8

n Port and queue egress shaper

n DiffServ (RFC 2474) and Tag remarking

o USB 2.0 Series B rear console interface for local system management
n Web interface
o Web based control and management interface over any Ethernet port

o Eight M12 connectors, 100BASE-T (100 Mbit/s) (Models: 09NM30-00 and 09NM30-01), or

o +10 W Max. (Models: 09NM30-00 and 09NM30-02)
o +85 W Max. with 60W PoE Max. (Models: 09NM30-01 and 09NM30-03)
Mechanical Specifications n Dimensions: Height 44.1 mm x Width 220 mm x Length 164 mm
n Weight: Less than 1.5 kg (depending on configuration)
